posts.body:
Introduction​
This is a game I've made to test some gameplay ideas. For now, only DEMO with around 30-60 min of gameplay is available. If you decide to try it out, please leave detailed feedback here.
Spoiler:
Celestial Seal
Celestial Seal​
is an old school RPG set in a world inspired by asian myths, history, and culture. Your task is to delve into the Depths, system of caverns and underground towns which meet sudden and yet unexplained end.
Exploration
The World of Celestial Seal is full of secret rooms, quests, and other mysteries. Finding them will reward you with useful items and information.
Story​
Gather information by talking with people, spirits, and reading descriptions to piece together what happened to those living in The Depths. Residents of this world are not always what they seem, enemies may become allies or the other way around.
Resource management​
You have 14 days to accomplish your task, keep an eye on your resources, light, food, potions, and scrolls are all neccessary tools of survival down in the Depths and you wouldn't want to run out of them in a critical moment.
Combat​
Train new skills from masters and search for enemy weaknesses to come out on top of hostile encounters.
Escape to fight another day or use the item you were hoarding to get out of the tight spot.
